transcripts.transcript: In a small pilot study, students who received weekly comments revised their drafts more often than those who received comments only at the end. The researchers say the result supports further investigation, but the sample came from one course. It does not yet show that the same approach would work equally well in every subject.
transcripts.target_signal: 区分研究观察与泛化结论
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The study compared two ways of presenting instructions. Students given worked examples completed the task more accurately, but they did not finish it significantly faster. The researchers therefore describe an improvement in accuracy rather than a general increase in every aspect of performance. A larger study is planned to examine different task types.
transcripts.target_signal: 辨认不同指标上的研究结果
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: Within this sample, longer practice was associated with better performance up to a certain point. Beyond that level, additional time showed little further benefit, especially when students became tired. The authors caution that the study does not establish one ideal number of hours for everyone, because the tasks and participants differed.
transcripts.target_signal: 识别研究发现中的上限与条件
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The two groups did not differ significantly on the final test. However, only a small number of students completed the study. The researchers say this limits their ability to detect a modest effect. They do not claim that the methods are identical or that further investigation would be pointless.
transcripts.target_signal: 区分未发现证据与证明不存在
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The team examined how quickly participants noticed errors in short written instructions. Those who checked each step against a worked example identified more errors. The study did not measure long-term memory or performance on unrelated tasks, so the authors restrict their conclusion to the checking activity used in the experiment.
transcripts.target_signal: 从相关研究中识别实际测量对象
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: A second study in another class produced a similar pattern: students using the checklist omitted fewer required steps. This makes the finding more credible, but both studies used closely related tasks. The researchers still want to know whether the benefit extends to unfamiliar situations where students must decide which steps are needed themselves.
transcripts.target_signal: 识别重复研究支持与尚未确定部分
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: In a small laboratory study, one group of mice learned a route with several landmarks. Another group used a route without them. After a week, the first group made fewer wrong turns, although the study did not test performance outside the laboratory.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析研究结论（仅六级）的含义与适用条件
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The researchers repeated the task after removing the familiar landmarks. The difference between the two groups became much smaller. They suggested that the mice had relied partly on those landmarks rather than learning the route independently of their surroundings.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析研究结论（仅六级）的含义与适用条件
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: A survey found that students who joined regular study groups reported greater confidence. However, the researchers did not assign students to groups at random. Students who were already confident may simply have been more willing to join.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析研究结论（仅六级）的含义与适用条件
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: Two classes used different revision schedules. One studied for a single long session, while the other spread the same total time across four days. A week later, the second class remembered more, but the classes had not been randomly assigned.
transcripts.target_signal: 结合题目材料辨析研究结论（仅六级）的含义与适用条件
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: The research team observed improved performance in a small group of experienced users. Before recommending the method more widely, they want to repeat the study with beginners and with people from different age groups.
transcripts.target_signal: 保留研究者对推广的限制
transcripts.pronunciation_notes: No dedicated pronunciation phenomenon; verify clear standard pronunciation across the complete transcript.

transcripts.transcript: Across the three trials, clear instructions were linked to fewer errors. The size of the difference varied, and one trial had only a small sample. The team described the pattern as promising while calling for further testing.
